The '''Biochemical Industrial District''' was a district in the [[Labor Valley]] region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was the location of several companies, including [[Ardus Industries]], the [[Corellian Chemical Corporation/Legends|Corellian Chemical Corporation]], the [[Beharen Droid Factory]], and the [[Saxan Chemical Refinery]].
